// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (256x256x512).
void solution(void) {
  // Hoist invariant Gemmini configuration outside of all loops to prevent redundant command dispatch
  gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

  // Initialize the accelerator once by flushing outside the loops
  gemmini_flush(0);

  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
    for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
      // Partial last M/N block: compute only the real rows/cols, pad the rest.
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK; if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK; if (mrows <= 0) continue;
      int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK; if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK; if (ncols <= 0) continue;
      
      // Stage only the tiny per-32-group scales; A/B data is mvin'd DIRECTLY
      // from DRAM (no host-side block memcpy — that was 98% of the cycles).
      for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
        memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);
        memcpy(&B_s[g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);
      }
      
      int tiles = BLK / DIM, tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
      uint32_t a_base = 0;
      uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles * tiles_K * DIM;
      int SPAD_DEST = 128;
      int pad_i = BLK - mrows, pad_j = BLK - ncols;
      
      // Load scale factors into scale memory
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, A_S_BYTES, 0);  // sel=0 for A/activation scales
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, B_S_BYTES, 1);  // sel=1 for B/weight scales
      
      // Load A tiles into scratchpad
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));  // Stride of A is K (in elements)
      for (int i = 0; i < tiles; i++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
          uint32_t spad_addr = a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM;
          void* dram_addr = (void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM);
          gemmini_extended_mvin(dram_addr, spad_addr, DIM, DIM);
        }
      }
      
      // Load B tiles into scratchpad
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));  // Stride of B is N (in elements)
      for (int j = 0; j < tiles; j++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
          uint32_t spad_addr = b_base + (k * tiles + j) * DIM;
          void* dram_addr = (void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM));
          gemmini_extended_mvin2(dram_addr, spad_addr, DIM, DIM);
        }
      }
      
      // Configure output store and requantization
      gemmini_config_st(BLK_OUTC * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, tiles, tiles, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);

      // Execute the weight-stationary matmul on tiles in scratchpad
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles, tiles, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0,
                           a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0, SPAD_DEST,
                           false, false, false, false, false,
                           NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // Read results from shared memory to DRAM
      for (int r = 0; r < mrows; r++) {
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[i0 * BLK + r][(j0 * BLK) / BF16_PER_WORD],
                             SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * BLK, ncols);
      }
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
